notes: NO TEXT LAYER: on this PDF the main dimensioned sheet (page index 1) has all lettering converted to vector outlines, so pg.get_text('words') returns only the footer and the guide's verbatim text check CANNOT be applied to it. Every value was read visually from crops at 3x to 5x zoom and cross-checked where possible by arithmetic (the bottom ordinates mirror about the centre and each pair sums to the 74.70 width: 24.34+50.36, 26.33+48.38, 30.01+44.70, 33.05+41.65; centreLine 2.82 is half of thickness 5.64). CAMERA PLATEAU EDGES ARE NOT DIMENSIONED anywhere in this PDF: the full-width bar is drawn in DETAIL D (sheet 1) and DETAIL N (sheet 3) but neither gives its bottom edge, side insets or radii, so x0/x1/y0/y1 are null; only its height off the back (3.03) and the items on it are dimensioned. The drawing writes the camera row y as '3X -16.29' (negative = downward); reported positive per the guide's y-down convention. Lens, rear mic and flash all sit inside an inner pill outline on the bar. Left view gives only the button width '3X 2.35' and no centre-line dimension, so centreLine is null for the three left buttons (right view gives 2.82). No SIM tray is drawn on this phone. Camera Control is flush (0.00 proud); other buttons 0.45 proud. Bottom ordinates: 24.34 26.33 30.01 33.05 41.65 44.70 48.38 50.36 (33.05 and 41.65 point at the two ends of the USB-C opening; width not dimensioned directly); the port row is positioned '6X 2.71' across the thickness (which face it is measured from was not determined).
